data.body: **[P1] A scope fatal observed during final resource shutdown is still acknowledged as a successful invocation.** After this check, the handler owner can publish `scopeFatal` while `onInvocationEnd` or `ExecutionManager.close()` blocks; `execute()` then returns the selected `PENDING`/`SUCCEEDED` outcome while the fatal only kills a daemon worker. Capture the selected outcome, close the manager, and recheck `scopeFatal` immediately before returning or rethrowing. Update the late-fatal regression to require caller propagation whenever the fatal is reported before `execute()` exits.
